brief.prompt: A smartphone mounted on a small tripod at eye level, facing a plain light-coloured wall beside a large window letting in soft daylight, in a tidy room. Shot from a slight side angle so both the phone and the even window light on the wall are clearly visible.
brief.alt: Phone on a tripod at eye level by a window, set up for a consistent face photo
brief.purpose: Shows the consistent photo setup (eye-level camera, even daylight, steady distance) that matters more than any golden ratio score when comparing photos.

review.alt: Smartphone clamped on a black tripod in a tidy, bright room, facing a plain light wall beside a large window, with soft daylight and window shadows falling evenly on the wall.
